prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: macOS study app icon concept for user selection. Create a single icon on a square canvas, no contact sheet, no captions, no letters, no watermark. This is a clean artwork concept to later separate into layers for Apple's Icon Composer, NOT a finished .icon export. Use crisp, vector-friendly shapes, front view, generous breathing room, strong legibility at 32px. Flat color, no baked specular effects, no glass texture, no bevel, no blur, no drop shadow, no 3D perspective. Full-bleed simple bright opaque background, no rounded square outer mask; the platform will provide the final enclosure. Keep the composition restrained and playful, at most two foreground groups. Input image is the user's original character design reference, not a target to reproduce as a screenshot. Preserve its distinctive simple dome arc head contour, two LARGE EMPTY ROUND outlined eyes, and one SMALL UPWARD CARET shaped mouth centered between and below the eyes. The eyes must remain open rings, not dots, not filled circles, not anime eyes. The mouth must be a tiny ^ shaped two-stroke mark, not a smile, not a beak. Keep the user's minimal hand-drawn charm, with clean dark outlines, white face, no hair, nose, eyebrows, cheeks, ears, or extra characters. Concept A: the character quietly reading an open book. Large rounded white face visible above a simple open book at lower center, tiny rounded hands holding the book edges. The open book has a simple softly colored cover, ivory pages and a center fold only, no text or page lines. Use a gentle light backdrop with a restrained accent color. The character face is the dominant recognizable shape, reading mood. No headband. Every contour deliberately simple. Output just this one app-icon artwork.
